title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
This incident shows a failure of platform-level safeguards for synthetic media. The deployment is an online video platform where users upload face-swapped pornographic videos, and the platform pays uploaders based on views while encouraging anonymity. The failure occurs at the hosting and distribution stage, after the videos are generated. The reports do not describe any pre-publication check that removed or blocked these manipulated videos. Catching it would have required detecting manipulated faces before publication, verifying uploader identity, or removing content quickly once reported.

The failure mode is impersonation through deepfake generation, producing non-consensual intimate imagery of identifiable people. It is not established from these reports that the platform operators intended to host this content, or that any of the new complaints have resulted in convictions. The one prior sentence involved a different presenter and does not establish liability for the platform.

summary:
Several well-known Dutch women are considering legal action after discovering themselves in manipulated pornographic videos on an online platform that attracts 13 million monthly visitors. The platform contains numerous fake videos featuring Dutch artists, television presenters, Olympic athletes, current and former government ministers, mayors, and members of the royal family. Justice Minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and urged victims to file reports. Multiple victims have already filed complaints or are pursuing legal action.

The deepfake videos work by superimposing a celebrity's face onto a pornographic actress. Users who upload material are encouraged to remain anonymous, likely to avoid prosecution, and they earn money based on video views. Legal experts warn that without government intervention, more fake videos will emerge. Deepfake pornography is prosecutable under revenge porn laws. Victims can file complaints with law enforcement, start legal claims, contact data protection authorities, or contact hosting companies. A previous case involved presenter Welmoed Sijtsma, whose offender received a conditional sentence of 180 hours in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
